package_name: Clinic Management & Medical Expert System - Knowledge Base Starter
important_note: Disease catalog entries and symptom vocabulary are a bilingual starter index. No disease-symptom mappings or diagnostic rules are activated because those require disease-specific evidence and clinical review. Do not use for diagnosis or treatment.
recommended_workflow: verify exact ICD-11 code and official title
attach disease-specific source URLs and access/review dates
write rule with inclusion/exclusion and safety conditions

sources.title: ICD-11 Browser / Classification
sources.use: Disease identity and classification; verify exact code per disease.

sources.title: MedlinePlus Health Topics
sources.use: General health topic background and symptom information; capture a disease-specific page and review date for each claim.

sources.title: WHO guidelines for clinical management of arboviral diseases: dengue, chikungunya, Zika and yellow fever (2025)
sources.use: Potential disease-specific clinical source for arboviral diseases; clinician must review applicability.

sources.title: Dengue and severe dengue fact sheet
